classification.difficultyReason: Choose unmarked decompositions of irregular grid figures into rectangles and triangles, tracking which component areas to add or subtract.

content.prompt: Imagine that the figures below have been drawn on $1\text{ cm}^2$ grid paper. Find the area of each.

spec.description: Triangle on a visible unit grid; native polygon geometry requires TikZ rather than a blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: Vertices (0,6), (4,0), (8,6), with downward-positive y; base 8 units and perpendicular height 6 units.
spec.answerVisibility: No calculated dimensions or area shown.

spec.description: Right-pointing arrow on a unit grid. Polygon geometry is not expressible by the blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle 2 by 2 joined to a triangle of base 4 and perpendicular height 1.

answer.worked:
Split the arrow into a rectangle and a triangle.
$$\begin{align*}A&=2\times2+\tfrac12\times4\times1\\A&=4+2\\A&=6\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Broad upper polygon with two chamfered corners and a narrow downward extension, on a unit grid.
spec.mathematics: A 5 by 5 square less two half-unit corner triangles, plus a 1 by 1 rectangle and a half-unit triangle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original boundary and grid are visible.

answer.worked:
Start with the $5\times5$ square, remove the two lower corner triangles, then add the downward extension.
$$\begin{align*}A&=5\times5-2\times\tfrac12\times1\times1+1\times1+\tfrac12\times1\times1\\A&=25-1+1+0.5\\A&=25.5\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium on a unit grid, reconstructed as a polygon.
spec.mathematics: Parallel sides 4 and 2 units; height 2 units.

answer.worked:
Split the figure into a central rectangle and two triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=2\times2+2\times\tfrac12\times1\times2\\A&=4+2\\A&=6\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Irregular polygon with a triangular top and two small triangular projections, on a unit grid.
spec.mathematics: A 3 by 3 rectangle plus triangles with base-height pairs (3,3), (1,1), (1,1).
spec.answerVisibility: No added dimensions, decomposition or result.

answer.worked:
Split the figure into a $3\times3$ rectangle, the upper triangle and two small triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=3\times3+\tfrac12\times3\times3+2\times\tfrac12\times1\times1\\A&=9+4.5+1\\A&=14.5\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
